name: Galileo Probe
about: Galileo Probe (1989-084, ARC), launched 1989 Oct 18. Its phases from GCAT: Venus, HCO, Jupiter, (951) Gaspra, Earth, (243) Ida. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Venus on GCAT's date); its perihelion 0.657 au and aphelion 0.995 au against GCAT's 0.668 and 0.997
